sloka: आर्तानाम् संश्रयः चैव यशसः च एक भाजनम् ।ज्ञान विज्ञान संपन्नो निदेशो निरतः पितुः ॥४-१५-२०॥
transliteration: ārtānām saṁśrayaḥ caiva yaśasaḥ ca eka bhājanam ।jñāna vijñāna saṁpanno nideśo nirataḥ pituḥ ॥4-15-20॥

translations.english: 'He is endowed with the knowledge of science and scriptures. He stood by his father's command. He is like a mine of virtues just as the lord of the mountain is a mine of minerals.
